parsedVerdict.reasoning: src/article/article.module.ts matches the presentation layer through the **/*.module.ts pattern. It is a NestJS feature module, and its only jobs are composition and transport-level setup. The @Module decorator registers the controller, the service provider and the TypeORM repositories for the entities. The configure() method attaches AuthMiddleware to specific HTTP routes and methods. Choosing which routes need authentication is an HTTP routing concern, which belongs in presentation. TypeOrmModule.forFeature only registers dependency-injection tokens. It does not query, map or transact, so it is wiring, not persistence logic. The file contains no business rules, domain invariants, persistence operations or application workflow. No responsibility from another layer kind is present.
